name: Binastra Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；公告主要涉及股份拆细/附加上市、股息派发、股东大会及关联交易授权等公司层面事项。最新一季（截至2026年7月31日）营收同比增长65.9%，净利润同比增长78.1%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments in its announcements; announcements mainly covered corporate-level matters such as share subdivision/additional listing, dividend payments, general meetings, and related party transaction mandates. For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue grew 65.9% year-on-year and net profit grew 78.1% year-on-year.
